title: Digi EQ
author: gdeo607
description: A 4-band master EQ on every output - main, headphones and USB alike - as a page of the master pages (FUNC+LFO) between Compressor and Internal Mixer. Knobs A-D: band level; press one for that band's Q. Knobs E-H: band frequency; press one for its type (HP, low shelf, bell, notch, band pass, high shelf, LP). The response curve is drawn above the knobs. The settings belong to the pattern: they live in the kit, so every pattern has its own EQ and it is saved with the project and kept over a power-off. SETTINGS > GLOBAL FX/MIX > MASTER EQ makes the EQ you can hear override every pattern's own.
